hold_reason: Refunds table does not match Alpha Co's reported refunds. Alpha reported order 240 (amount_cents 8145) as applied, but list_refunds returns only order 243 (13498) and order 245 (10428). The refund for order 240 is missing from the ledger, so no payouts were recorded. Please have W2/Alpha Co confirm whether the order 240 refund was applied before this batch is released.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone I need to verify the refunds table matches Alpha's reported refunds, so I'll start by listing the refunds.
The refunds table is missing order 240 (8145 cents), which Alpha reported as applied. The instructions say a mismatch means I must hold before any payout, and payouts can't be recalled.
